entities.summary: Manuel Bañuelos is a Mexican professional baseball pitcher for the Sultanes de Monterrey of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves, Chicago White Sox, New York Yankees, and Pittsburgh Pirates. He has also played in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Fubon Guardians and Rakuten Monkeys, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles.
